operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case quoted table names: "Business_Attributes", "Business_Categories", "Business_Hours", "Checkins", "Elite", "Reviews", "Tips", "Users_Compliments", "Business", "Users" — must be double-quoted in generated SQL; unquoted lowercase lookups collide with unquoted tables Attributes/Categories/Compliments/Days/Years.

DDL declares FKs as bare `references Business` / `references Attributes` with no parent column; pragma foreign_key_list returns parent_col NULL -> parent column = child column name (business_id, attribute_id, etc.).
All FKs resolve to existing parents (parent_exists true everywhere); no dangling FKs, no self-references.

Composite PKs on 8 tables (Business_Attributes, Business_Categories, Business_Hours, Checkins, Elite, Reviews, Tips, Users_Compliments); single-column PKs on Attributes, Categories, Compliments, Days, Years, Business, Users.

Reviews is 322906 rows (> max_rows_per_table 300000) -> rowid % k sampling path exercised; Business_Attributes 206934, Users_Compliments 98810, Tips 87157, Checkins 80038, Business_Hours 47831, Business_Categories 43703, Elite 16366, Business 15585, Users 70817.
All columns notnull=0 (no NOT NULL constraints), no CHECK, no UNIQUE indexes beyond PKs; declared types only INTEGER/TEXT/REAL.

Storage class contradicts declared type: many TEXT columns hold numeric-looking strings (user_average_stars '4.0', review_count 'Low'/'Medium'/'High'/'Uber', number_of_compliments 'Medium', user_votes_* 'Low'/'None'/'Uber'); Years.year_id INTEGER holds 2005..2014 (year-like ints, not 1..N).

TEXT columns hold small closed vocabularies: active {true,false}, state {AZ,SC,CA}, review_length/tip_length {Short,Medium,Long}, label_time_* {None,Low,Medium,High,Uber}, attribute_value {none,full_bar,beer_and_wine,false,true}, opening_time/closing_time {8AM..12PM} style.
Business.stars is REAL with 9 distinct values (3.0,4.5,...) — Number fuzzer with scale from REAL (no args) will draw wide floats, not the 1..5 star grid.
Users.user_yelping_since_year INTEGER 2008..2013 and Years.actual_year 2005..2014 are year-valued INTEGERs; declared type INTEGER dispatches to Number, not Year fuzzer (no 'year' in type string).
Checkins has 24 label_time_N TEXT columns each with 3-5 distinct values; String fuzzer will generate random charset strings, not the label vocabulary.
All null_rate 0.0 in original; distinct counts small for lookup tables (Days 7, Compliments 11, Years 10, Attributes 80, Categories 591).
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INTEGER/REAL columns: full range [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale 0 for INTEGER -> [-1,1] plus +-1/+-2 perturbation; REAL scale 0 too since no (a,b) args) — produces tiny ints for business_id/user_id, so joins still work but cardinalities collapse.
String fuzzer on all TEXT columns: random a-zA-Z 0-9() strings length 0..20 with 0.5 contaminate; will NOT reproduce 'Low'/'Medium'/'Uber'/'true'/'8AM' vocabularies unless literal pool supplies them.

Literal pool from train SQL will seed some TEXT columns (state, active, review_length, label_time_*) with real values via type_values_w_db loose anchoring; columns never compared in train SQL get pure random strings.
Composite-PK tables: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate (business_id,user_id) tuples; with tiny Number ranges on business_id/user_id, many rows collapse -> small tables, few distinct FK pairs.

FK child columns draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement; parent Business.business_id after PK dedup is small (Number range ~[-1,1] perturbed) so all child business_id values cluster in a handful of ints -> joins trivially match, missing the real 1..15585 spread.
Years.year_id INTEGER gets Number fuzzer values ~[-1,1], not 2005..2014; Elite.year_id FK to Years then holds tiny ints; queries filtering year_id=2010 return empty -> FN.
Business.stars REAL gets Number scale 0 -> values in [-1,1] plus +-0.01/+-0.02, not 1..5; AVG(stars) comparisons against 4.0 fail -> FN.
review_stars INTEGER 1..5 gets Number [-1,1] perturbed -> mostly 0,1,2,-1; WHERE review_stars=5 returns empty -> FN.
likes INTEGER 0..3 gets Number [-1,1] -> 0,1,-1,2; WHERE likes>2 rare -> FN.
TEXT columns with numeric-looking content (user_average_stars '4.0') get String fuzzer random strings, so CAST/compare to 4.0 fails -> FN.

Small lookup tables (Days 7, Compliments 11, Years 10) get choose_table_sizes sizes 1..2500; if size < distinct original, FK children reference only generated subset -> some parent lookups miss -> FN.
Missing ties/duplicates: PK dedup + unique dedup removes duplicate rows that real data has (e.g. multiple Reviews per business), so GROUP BY/COUNT queries undercount -> FP on count comparisons.
